sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – long-term full-volume commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. To support your capacity planning, we propose a firm long-term commitment for the 24 mm mechanical seal (part:340010):

- Volume: 23,400 pcs/year (our full need)
- Contract term: 36 months
- Lead time: 56 days
- Unit price: EUR 25.04
- Payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling, no index clause

This gives you full-volume, long-term commitment and more scheduling room. For reference, our orders for this seal on 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-21 were both at EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10).

Which aspect of this package would need adjustment for you to confirm it?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – long-term full-volume commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. The historical prices you cite do not reflect our current capacity utilisation and market conditions. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month contract at 23,400 units per year with a 56-day lead time. To accommodate your requested terms, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 32.10. 

To summarise our offer, we state a price of €32.10 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

evidence.claim: Final offer: EUR 32.10/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, 36 months, 56 days, ppm 300, no chargeback. Payment 30 days, DAP, no index clause, no tooling.
The supplier confirmed our cited September order prices of EUR 29.89 are accurate. It said they do not reflect current capacity utilisation.
The public-formula cost of offer:70410-1 is EUR 1,551,230.40. This is above the user's benchmark of about EUR 1,497,925.17 for 72/100, so the target is missed on public costs.
With no alternative supplier, covering the full need at EUR 32.10 is far cheaper than buying the shortfall at the fallback price of EUR 37.36 plus fallback risk.
Our buyer should-cost estimate is EUR 24.31 excluding margin (±5%). It is not a proven supplier floor and was not used before the supplier declared finality.
